technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early reversal signals (RSI rising, StochRSI cross-up) are offset by pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, MACD negative, no momentum confirmation), making this a high-risk bounce attempt rather than a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MKC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated volatility risk with earnings 13 days away.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent recent congressional conviction and news data limits conviction; neutral AAII sentiment (22% neutral, 58% bearish) suggests caution despite fear extremity.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (406.4), flat yield curve signals recession risk, FOMC just occurred, earnings in 13 days, and credit stress evident—highly unfavourable environment for Consumer Staples trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI (9 & 14) with StochRSI cross-up and fear-zone contrarian signal (11/100) offer classic bounce setup from support at 76.13.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, MACD negative, no momentum confirmation), crisis VIX, high earnings risk in 13 days, and unfavourable macro environment make this a low-probability trap bounce rather than swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI and StochRSI cross-up offer classic bounce setup, but pervasive bearish structure (price below all MAs, MACD negative, no momentum confirmation) and crisis macro environment (VIX 406.4, earnings in 13 days) make this a low-probability trap rather than high-conviction swing entry.

decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical bounce signals offset by structural weakness, fundamental vacuum, and macro crisis
decision.portfolio_note: Zero sector concentration risk, but 77 open positions and crisis macro environment argue for capital preservation over low-conviction contrarian bounce attempts.
